episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: A Western about a former Confederate soldier (Anson Mount) and his quest for revenge on the Union troops who killed his wife. In the premiere episode, he heads west to take a job helping to construct the first transcontinental railroad.

episodes.title: Immoral Mathematics
episodes.summary: Cullen's deadly actions leave him in a battle for his life; Lily fights to survive her plight in the wilderness; Durant tries to turn a tragedy into a political advantage.

episodes.title: A New Birth of Freedom
episodes.summary: An unexpected obstacle impedes Cullen's search for the sergeant; Durant convenes a search party to track down Lily in the wilderness.

episodes.title: Jamais je ne t'oublierai
episodes.summary: Cullen's search for the sergeant nears its end; Durant keeps to his hidden agenda while assisting in Lily's recuperation.

episodes.title: Bread and Circuses
episodes.summary: A bare-knuckle brouhaha between Elam and Cullen is spurred by Durant's latest attempt to deal with the railroad's financial crisis.

episodes.title: Pride, Pomp and Circumstance
episodes.summary: Durant challenges the Cheyenne to a competition in an effort to bring a halt to ongoing negotiations. Meanwhile, Elam and Cullen try to prevent bloodshed in town.

episodes.title: Revelations
episodes.summary: Elam's life hangs in the balance, leaving Cullen with a monumental decision to make. Meanwhile, Durant risks his financial fortune, and Lily confronts her late husband's relatives.

episodes.title: Derailed
episodes.summary: Elam and Cullen are assigned a mission of vengeance by Durant. Meanwhile, Lily tries to settle in at the settlement.

episodes.title: Timshel
episodes.summary: A looming railroad deadline throws Cullen and Lily together; Joseph and Elam deal with what their violent mission has wrought.

episodes.title: God of Chaos
episodes.summary: In the Season 1 finale, Cullen's past and future collide, impacting his life on the railroad.

episodes.title: Viva La Mexico
episodes.summary: In the Season 2 premiere, Durant and Lily steer the railroad further west, while Cullen and Elam land on opposite sides of the law.

episodes.title: Durant, Nebraska
episodes.summary: Durant confronts a formidable threat to the rolling city, while a horrific crime leads Lily and Elam to join forces in order to attain justice.

episodes.title: Slaughterhouse
episodes.summary: Cullen struggles to maintain order while Mickey's and Sean's lives are endangered; Lily and Elam clean up a mess of their own doing.

episodes.title: Scabs
episodes.summary: A tragedy leads Cullen to defuse an internal threat to the railroad.

episodes.title: The Railroad Job
episodes.summary: Cullen's past catches up with him and threatens the fate of the railroad.

episodes.title: Purged Away with Blood
episodes.summary: Despite fighting to save his own life, Durant must try to keep the railroad from going under. Meanwhile, Cullen comes to the aid of an old comrade.

episodes.title: The White Spirit
episodes.summary: The aftermath of the tragedy leaves Lily and Cullen struggling to maintain order, while Elam plans for the future.

episodes.title: The Lord's Day
episodes.summary: A new arrival stirs things up in Hell on Wheels, while Eva gets caught between Elam and Mr. Toole.

episodes.title: Blood Moon
episodes.summary: Cullen gears up for battle as the town celebrates.

episodes.title: Blood Moon Rising
episodes.summary: Cullen battles to save Hell on Wheels in the Season 2 finale.

episodes.title: Big Bad Wolf
episodes.summary: In the Season 3 opener, Cullen and Elam travel to New York to secure their positions on the railroad. Meanwhile, Durant fights for his legacy from prison.

episodes.title: Eminent Domain
episodes.summary: Cullen is forced to make a difficult decision; a reporter arrives in Hell on Wheels; and Elam has trouble with his new boss.

episodes.title: Range War
episodes.summary: An attack on the cattle pens sends Cullen and Elam into the prairie in search of their stolen food. Then, a stranger's arrival threatens Elam's family.

episodes.title: The Game
episodes.summary: After a railroad accident, Cullen and Elam forge deep into Indian territory to secure a new lumber source. Meanwhile, Durant tells Louise a secret about Cullen.

episodes.title: Searchers
episodes.summary: Cullen helps Elam track down a dangerous criminal. Meanwhile, chaos erupts in Hell on Wheels as the town prepares to move down the tracks.

episodes.title: One Less Mule
episodes.summary: Cullen's position is threatened after Durant files an injunction against the Union Pacific. Meanwhile, Elam deals with a dangerous newcomer.

episodes.title: Cholera
episodes.summary: A cholera epidemic in Hell on Wheels has Cullen seeking fresh water to help save his workers. Meanwhile, Durant faces political fallout.

episodes.title: It Happened in Boston
episodes.summary: After his workers defect to the Mormons, Cullen recruits Durant to help get them back. Meanwhile, Sean and Mickey's past comes back to haunt them.

episodes.title: Fathers and Sins
episodes.summary: With Gen. Grant's deadline looming, a gang of riders attacks Cheyenne while Cullen and Elam pay Durant a visit.

episodes.title: Get Behind the Mule
episodes.summary: In the Season 3 finale, Cullen deals with consequences, and Elam mounts a rescue attempt. Meanwhile, Durant receives Gen. Grant and the U.P. board in Cheyenne ahead of the deadline.

episodes.title: The Elusive Eden
episodes.summary: Season 4 opens with Cullen awaiting the birth of his baby while laboring under the Swede at Fort Smith. Meanwhile, Durant deals with the fallout from a railroad accident.

episodes.title: Escape from the Garden
episodes.summary: Cullen challenges the Swede while planning his exit from Fort Smith. Meanwhile, a new adversary arrives and makes his presence felt in Cheyenne.

episodes.title: Chicken Hill
episodes.summary: Cullen goes back to work on the railroad and butts heads with his new boss. Meanwhile, Durant and Campbell clash over a valuable piece of real estate.

episodes.title: Reckoning
episodes.summary: Cullen faces trouble at home as he takes railroad matters into his own hands. Meanwhile, Campbell makes a move against Durant and Mickey.

episodes.title: Life's a Mystery
episodes.summary: A stranger's arrival stirs up old feelings in Cullen and puts his family at risk. Meanwhile, the Swede faces consequences at Fort Smith.

episodes.title: Bear Man
episodes.summary: Following an attack by a bear, Elam struggles to survive in a Comanche village and find his way back to Cheyenne.

episodes.title: Elam Ferguson
episodes.summary: Cullen attempts to reconnect with Elam upon his return. Meanwhile, Durant takes matters into his own hands while putting an old problem to rest.

episodes.title: Under Color of Law
episodes.summary: Cullen makes a decision to ensure his family's safety. Meanwhile, Campbell hires a new federal marshal to clean up the streets.

episodes.title: Two Trains
episodes.summary: Cullen goes head-to-head with the new marshal in an attempt to free his arrested railroad workers. Meanwhile, Campbell confronts Louise over a story.

episodes.title: Return to Hell
episodes.summary: An act of terror strikes Cheyenne as Cullen, Durant and Campbell negotiate toward a settlement for policing the streets.

episodes.title: Bleeding Kansas
episodes.summary: Cullen and Durant fight to save the life of a criminal. Meanwhile, Louise tries to provide support as Ruth copes with a great loss.

episodes.title: Thirteen Steps
episodes.summary: Cullen grapples with Ruth's unexpected decision; Louise jeopardizes her reputation to fight for a story she believes in.

episodes.title: Further West
episodes.summary: As the railroad prepares to leave Cheyenne behind in the Season 4 finale, Cullen returns to Fort Smith to retrieve his family.

episodes.title: Chinatown
episodes.summary: Cullen is in California with the Central Pacific Railroad, and must deal with the new workers.

episodes.title: Mei Mei
episodes.summary: Cullen enlists new workers to help him move a locomotive on a sled.

episodes.title: White Justice
episodes.summary: Cullen must deal with the violence in Chinatown, caused by disgruntled workers.

episodes.title: Struck
episodes.summary: Cullen solves a Chinese labor strike in the wake of violence. Meanwhile, Durant pulls Mickey deeper into Union Pacific business.

episodes.title: Elixir of Life
episodes.summary: Unexpected violence erupts in Chinatown during the festival of Tin Hau Don; Cullen confronts the Swede; and Durant involves Maggie in his latest scheme.

episodes.title: Hungry Ghosts
episodes.summary: Cullen and Mei take a dangerous journey through the California wilderness, escorting precious cargo. Meanwhile, Eva nurses Louise back to health.

episodes.title: False Prophets
episodes.summary: Cullen and Durant reunite in Salt Lake City to meet with President Grant about the future of the railroad. Meanwhile, Swede enacts his plan against the Mormons.

episodes.title: Two Soldiers
episodes.summary: The Swede's murderous rampage on the Hatch homestead results in a long overdue showdown with Cullen.

episodes.title: Return to the Garden
episodes.summary: Cullen faces life-changing decisions in Utah as Truckee adapts to life without him. Meanwhile, Durant's lies compromise his new partner.

episodes.title: 61 Degrees
episodes.summary: Cullen's nitroglycerin experiment provides an explosive backdrop for the railroad life in Truckee. Meanwhile, Durant's plan turns deadly.

episodes.title: Gambit
episodes.summary: Mickey's dirty business with Durant leaves him with blood on his hands. Meanwhile, Campbell's return to town complicates Louise's life.

episodes.title: Any Sum Within Reason
episodes.summary: Chang discovers Mei's secret and forces her to flee Truckee. Meanwhile, Cullen's search for her brings new realizations while exorcising old demons.

episodes.title: Railroad Men
episodes.summary: The race to finish the railroad comes down to inches, forcing all parties to contemplate the end of the line and what the future holds for them.

episodes.title: Done
episodes.summary: The golden spike, government hearings and unpredictable actions mean new beginnings and endings for the survivors.
